Name: Operating checking
Notes: Card batches and patient financing payouts land here

Name: Pharmacy and food inventory
Notes: Optional on cash basis. Use it if you count the pharmacy each month

Name: Medical equipment
Notes: X-ray, ultrasound, dental units, anesthesia machines, at cost

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Distributor and reference lab invoices not yet paid

Name: Client deposits
Notes: Deposits taken before surgery or boarding and not yet used

Name: Sales tax payable
Notes: Tax on retail and food sales where it applies

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll report

Name: Business credit card
Notes: The payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Equipment loans
Notes: Principal owed on financed equipment. Split each payment between this line and interest expense

Name: Exam and service revenue
Notes: Exams, surgery, dentistry, hospitalization, diagnostics. Includes services paid through patient financing, at the full bill

Name: Pharmacy and food sales
Notes: Medications, preventives, prescription diets

Name: Boarding and grooming
Notes: Optional. Only if the clinic offers them

Name: Drugs and medical supplies
Notes: Distributor invoices

Name: Outside lab and imaging fees
Notes: Reference labs, radiology reads

Name: Cremation and aftercare
Notes: Amounts paid to the cremation provider

Name: Wages
Notes: Vets, technicians, front desk, from the payroll report

Name: Payroll taxes
Notes: Employer share from the payroll report

Name: Merchant and financing fees
Notes: Card processor fees and patient financing provider fees

Name: Practice software
Notes: Practice management and client reminder software

Name: Insurance
Notes: Professional liability and property

Name: Interest expense
Notes: Interest part of equipment loan payments
